Como Penso Como foi uma gastroperformanc: Como Penso Como was a gastroperformance held at Sesc Pompéia in 2013 and Casa Electrolux in 2015. The project brought together food, theatre, music and multimedia to discuss Brazilian history and cultural identity. In nine scenes and nine dishes, the experience went through ancient rituals, medieval banquets, faith and came to the present, criticizing both fast food and high gastronomy elitist and repetitive. The proposal was to think about eating, not just consuming. Each dish, created from 60 recipes, represented symbols of Brazil such as the Anthropophagic Manifesto, Tropicalism and Cinema Novo. The scenography and food used design techniques: crispy cassava luminary, edible papers, graviola lace and chocolate in 3D, creating a sensory journey through Brazilian culture without attempting to define it.

Árvore comestível celebra a biodiversida: An edible tree celebrates Brazilian biodiversity and the relationship between humans and nature.
Pé de Verso, de 2018, foi uma gastroperf: Pé de Verso (2018) was a gastroperformance created for chef Alex Atala’s FRU.TO at the invitation of ApexBrasil. Using a tree as a symbol of the relationship between humankind and nature, visitors “picked” edible fruit from the installation. The menu celebrated Brazilian biodiversity with native ingredients from four biomes: baru and mangaba from the Cerrado; guaraná, cupuaçu and açaí from the Amazon; seriguela and cashew from the Caatinga; and cambuci from the Atlantic Forest. The recipes featured wild Amazonian cacao, umburana cachaça and chocolate colored with natural dyes. The presentation evoked Pernambuco’s bolo de rolo.

No Taste Brasil 2025, a convite da Migra: At Taste Brasil 2025, Migraflix and Electrolux invited the gastroperformance “Mulher, Vida, Liberdade”, which asked what freedom tastes like and proposed tasting what we create. The experience began with Mah Mooni and Leo Bianchini singing in Persian what many women still have to whisper. To Iranian melodies, visitors received a sheet of words and images relating to the 2022 protests in Iran and their slogan, “Mulher, Vida, Liberdade”. Each participant then made an original collage with these elements on a base of green-apple gelatin, creating an edible mosaic. Freedom thus became a sensory, bodily experience joining sound, image and tasting.

Mesa escultórica inspirada nos Andes con: A sculptural table inspired by the Andes leads a sensory experience centered on Don Melchor wine.
O jantar foi concebido para celebrar o v: The dinner was conceived to celebrate Don Melchor 2021, named the world’s best wine, and drew inspiration from the Andes, where Concha y Toro’s vineyards are located. A long, winding stone-serpent sculpture stretched across the table like Chile, covered with lavender meringues resembling snow-capped peaks. At the end of dinner, guests were invited to take the meringues and add them to an aromatic pavlova in an interactive, poetic gesture. The starter surprised guests because the dish was itself edible: a stone-shaped wagyu escondidinho. The menu also included dried grape-leaf canapés with baccalà mantecato, black-rice crackers with charcuterie pâté, and pressed lamb with charred onions as the main course.

Experiência sobre futuros possíveis que: An experience about possible futures connecting food, technology, nature and collective intelligence.
Para celebrar 100 anos da Electrolux no: To celebrate 100 years of Electrolux in Brazil and 10 years of Taste São Paulo 2026, the brand presents the gastroperformance POIÉSIS, created by artist Simone Mattar. The experience translates in a sensory and contemporary way the territories of the brand — Innovation to Live Well, Tastes that Welcome and Home with Soul — by uniting technology, food, architecture and coexistence in an immersive and shared journey. POIÉSIS brings together flavors, sound landscapes, projections and edible sculptures in a space designed to welcome and create new forms of connection between people. The trajectory of a century of Electrolux in Brazilian houses is evoked by native ingredients and unexpected combinations, proposing a relationship with food that is creative, affective and cultural. More than an installation, it is a living sensory ecosystem where the past and future meet in the present and living well means living together. The name refers to the concept of Poiesis, the act of creating and bringing something new to existence, aligned with brand innovation. Technology appears as a human expression of world transformation, dissolving the dichotomy between artificial and natural, and the final challenge is to develop an ethics of existence to guide creations and choices that ensure the continuity of the planet.
Cinco atos aproximam cidade e natureza p: Five acts approach city and nature through projections, music, matter and high gastronomy.
A convite da Animale e inspirada pelo co: At Animale’s invitation and inspired by its Urban Flora collection, Simone Mattar conceived a gastroperformance that orchestrated different artistic languages to offer the brand’s guests an immersive, multisensory experience. The experience suspends the opposition between nature and culture and reveals, through images, sounds and flavors, the persistence of life, which takes root wherever it finds a crack. The tension between the calculated geometry of cities and the exuberant organic forms of our flora informs Mattar’s work. Celebrating the complementarity of these forces guided its conception in five acts: lava, concrete, concrete poetry, moss and flowers.

Camafeus comestíveis projetam rostos, me: Edible cameos project faces, memories and conflicts of belonging in an anthropophagic experience.
35 Fragmentos, de Simone Mattar, estreou: 35 Fragmentos, by Simone Mattar, premiered at the Brazilian Embassy in Madrid in 2015 and was presented again at SP-Arte in 2016 and Senac Aclimação in 2018. For audiences of up to 40 per session, the work combined gastronomy, theater, music and visual art. On a table, 35 edible cameos bore projections of real faces recounting fears, memories and conflicts of belonging. The voices grew into a cacophony until the heads suggested their own anthropophagic sacrifice, inviting visitors to eat them. As they were devoured, the projections became grotesque. Inside, the heads held flavors such as smoked-eggplant mousse, grain salad with pomegranate, six-cheese mousse, chocolate crémeux, corn custard with guava paste, and crunchy paçoca and coconut.
Escultura comestível aborda a nuvem radi: An edible sculpture explores the radioactive cloud of Chernobyl and its invisible effects on the land.
Nuvem Negra, de 2015, é uma instalação d: Nuvem Negra (2015) is an installation by the Food of War collective presented in “Clouded Lands”, an exhibition about the relationship between armed conflict and food. The work was shown in Madrid, Kyiv, Berlin and Burgos from 2015 to 2017. Inspired by Svetlana Aleksiévitch’s book “Voices from Chernobyl”, it addresses the 1986 nuclear explosion at the Chernobyl power plant and its consequences. The installation reflects on the radioactive cloud that mainly affected Belarus, where the Soviet government seeded clouds to divert rain away from populated areas, sacrificing around 10,000 km². For decades, residents did not know which foods were contaminated. The work materializes this tension as a black mushroom-shaped cloud made of cotton candy: visitors could eat something sweet yet visually threatening, drawing a parallel with food insecurity and the authorities’ concealment of the truth.

Maçãs pretas comestíveis e falsas recria: Edible and imitation black apples recreate the uncertainty of food contamination after Chernobyl.
A produção agrícola da região de Chernob: Agricultural production in the Chernobyl region was profoundly affected by the 1986 nuclear accident. In the decades that followed, despite life flourishing again, people in the affected areas could not distinguish food contaminated by radiation from food safe to eat.
Nesta gastroperformance, 50 maçãs pretas: In this gastroperformance, 50 black apples are offered to the public, who cannot tell which are plastic and which are made of delicious chocolate and cream. Through this engaging interaction, the lottery of contamination is reenacted so visitors can experience something of a problem that affects Chernobyl residents every day.

The installation consisted of small chocolate cubes on three surfaces of a much larger cube inspired by the concrete artwork of sculptor Franz Weissmann.
A arte concreta foi um movimento importa: Concrete art was an important movement in Brazilian art and design in the early twentieth century. Over the four days of the fair, a kitchen specially assembled for the occasion processed a total of 500 kg of chocolate and served 2,000 units of cubes per day.

Jantar em cinco tempos que articula proj: A five-course dinner combining projection, sound and food to explore memory, truth and displacement.
A gastroperformance Aleteia explora os d: The gastroperformance Aleteia explores how memory unfolds across space and time and poetically investigates bodily, geographic and spiritual itinerancy. Its research draws on three works that take a traveler’s perspective and reach the same conclusion: only movement leads to eternity. Chris Marker’s essay film Sans Soleil argues that remembering is a form of time travel and structures its narrative around the rhythm of memories rather than linear time, moving through Japan, Guinea-Bissau, Iceland and elsewhere. In Flights, Olga Tokarczuk pays tribute to the traveler through short vignettes about departure, waiting, the road and arrival, suggesting that movement is nobler than rest and that what moves may last forever. In Invisible Cities, Italo Calvino, through Marco Polo’s voice, shows memory as a mixture of imagination and reality: the traveler becomes a poet and the map a metaphor. For him, remembering is a poetic and existential act of continuing to create the world, even what has been lost. Aletheia emerges from this reflection on memory, time and displacement, bringing these three perspectives together to consider displacement as a language of memory.
Manifesto poético transforma a comida em: A poetic manifesto turns food into a sensory, metaphorical and anthropophagic language.
Lo Come Lo Cura (2021) é um manifesto in: Lo Come Lo Cura (2021) is a provocative manifesto in which food is a poetic tool and eating becomes a contrapuntal experience, demanding metaphorical, sensory and even anthropophagic involvement. Design, gastronomy and creative expression work together to make food a form of total art. This gastroperformance is a creative work included in “Gastronomic languages in popular graphics in Bogotá’s markets: case studies of the La Concordia, La Perseverancia and Las Cruces project”, coordinated by the Department of Gastronomy and Culinary Arts at Areandina’s School of Design, Communication and Fine Arts.

Instalação suspensa que transforma o ato: A suspended installation turns eating into a reflection on hunger and inequality.
Fome Come, de 2012, foi um coquetel perf: Fome Come (2012) was a performative cocktail event at the 30th São Paulo Biennial that playfully linked food to global socioeconomic realities. The work contrasted countries in the Northern Hemisphere, associated with abundance, with those in the Southern Hemisphere, marked by hunger and poverty. Hundreds of little boxes hung at eye level, each containing a delicacy from a different part of the world made from a specific recipe, such as dried-beef pie with Catupiry cheese for Brazil and Moroccan couscous for Africa. The sides of the boxes bore the word COME (“EAT”), while their colors formed the word FOME (“HUNGER”) underneath, reflected in a mirror on the floor. As guests removed the boxes to eat, the installation gradually disappeared, as did the reflected word FOME, while real hunger was satisfied.

Doces em forma de morango escondem grilo: Strawberry-shaped sweets conceal chocolate-covered crickets and reveal contradictions in the act of eating.
Morangos Carnívoros, de 2018, fez parte: Morangos Carnívoros (2018) was part of a Food of War collective exhibition at Zonamaco in Mexico City. The gastroperformance prompted reflection on extreme positions around food, particularly veganism. Ironically, many vegans consume gelatin and jams colored with carmine, a natural dye made from cochineal insects. Synthetic dyes such as Red 40 are also questioned because of possible health risks. Playing with this contradiction and the Mexican tradition of eating insects, the project offered sweets shaped like juicy red strawberries. Each concealed a chocolate-covered fried cricket. The work shows that eating goes beyond ideals: it involves culture, tradition and contradictions, and even frustrated expectations can bring pleasure.

Experiência inspirada na reciprocidade,: An experience inspired by reciprocity, in which fire, affection and choice guide a collective journey.
A gastroperformance “Dádiva” foi apresen: The gastroperformance “Dádiva” was presented in the Biennial Pavilion during Geração Senac, an event for young people from public schools. It drew on Marcel Mauss’s theory of reciprocity, which sees mutual exchange as a social principle. In the first act, participants receive an edible chocolate matchstick that bursts when bitten, symbolizing the spark of affection, and pass through a tunnel of flames to meet a performer who hands them the “fire of affection”, representing the multiplication of that energy. In the final act, the performer invites each person to reflect on where they want to kindle this flame and to place it in a pot of gold, a gesture symbolizing the growth of desire and marked by the inflation of a legend. The symbolism is then explained: fire as beginning and first action, water as the persistence of will. To close, each person chooses a water or fire biscuit according to the symbolic quality they most need.
Luminárias de gelatina colorida convidam: Colored gelatin lamps invite visitors to eat the light and transform the installation.
Gelúminas, Poesia Luminofágica de 2005 f: Gelúminas, Poesia Luminofágica (2005) was created for the first International Design Exhibition, themed “The Safe Nest”, which explored the relationship between people and their homes. Curated by Nicola Goretti of Grupo AG and funded by Centro Cultural Banco do Brasil, the installation was later presented again at Centro Cultural dos Correios in Rio and on other occasions. Visitors entered a room with three large lamps made from around 3,000 cups of colored gelatin, each bearing a letter that together formed the phrase “Coma luz” (“Eat light”). A looping audio track invited people to eat the cocktail-flavored gelatin. The work brought sight, sound, touch, smell and taste together to consider the home as a place of control and safety, where food and light ward off the darkness outside, while also pointing to its fragility and ironically recalling the fashion at the time for people who claimed to “live on light”.
Ópera gastronômica em três atos que usa: A gastronomic opera in three acts that uses the pig as a metaphor for human paradoxes.
Ópera dos Porcos é uma gastroperformance: Ópera dos Porcos is a gastroperformance by Simone Mattar that uses the pig as a metaphor for human paradoxes: wealth and poverty, celebration and revulsion, luck and greed. Behind the pig are people, and behind gastronomy, beauty. Structured in three acts like a lyric opera, the work combines visual art, electronic interventions and gastronomy. Everything is sung and staged so visitors experience the absurd and extravagant, moving between the serious and the comic, the reflective and the everyday. Opera, an art that has served peoples and aristocracies from the Renaissance to the present, is reinvented here. Just as the pig has endured for centuries in the recipes of enslaved people, the bourgeoisie and the nobility, Ópera dos Porcos imagines it continuing to inhabit the dreams of cooks and poets, showing that, despite all its artifice, opera remains one of the most powerful ways to create chimeras — even on the palate.

Uma gastroperformance é um projeto artís: A gastroperformance is an artistic project. For this reason, its commissioning terms differ from those of corporate projects.
Insira o código enviado junto ao seu con: Enter the code sent along with your invitation to access the material prepared for you.
O código identifica a apresentação desti: The code identifies the presentation for your access.
O presente projeto prevê a publicação de: This project provides for the publication of a book focused on the action Como Penso Como, designed by Simone Mattar and held at Sesc Pompeia in 2013. Since then, the artist has developed a series of propositions gathered under the notion of gastroperformance, a concept that allows her to articulate food practices to the fields of art, anthropology, philosophy, design, public health and socio-environmental studies. Since the artist's method already structured this seminal intervention, the project resumes Como Penso Como as a starting point and guiding thread to present and analyze the theoretical and methodological foundations of gastroperformance.
A noção de gastroperformance consolidou-: The notion of gastroperformance was consolidated in dialogue with projects in which Mattar mobilizes ingredients, ways of preparation and spatial solutions to compose food rituals expanded by images, sounds, bodies and words. Converted into research object and language, these commensal rituals allow the artist to produce critical utterances that articulate the symbolic and sensory dimensions of food. Sustained by rigorous investigations and attentive to the materiality of the processes, the artist builds essayistic works on transversal themes, such as Brazilian identity, utopias, memory, dádiva and the frictions between nature and culture.
A publicação organiza-se em duas partes: The publication is organized into two complementary parts to account for the conceptual and practical dimension of the work. The first part is dedicated to mapping the issues that theoretically and methodologically support gastroperformance, examining its transdisciplinary interfaces. The second part focuses specifically on the Como Penso Como project, gathering essays from invited researchers in which each chapter analyzes one of the dishes that integrate the action, contemplating its poetic, material and conceptual implications.
Como Penso Como foi uma gastroperformanc: Como Penso Como was a gastroperformance first presented at Sesc Pompeia in São Paulo in 2013, and again in 2015, at Casa Electrolux. The action simultaneously uses culinary, musical, theatrical, scenic and multimedia resources to establish a direct relationship between the act of eating and critical questions present in striking aspects of Brazilian history, literature, gastronomy and culture.
A gastroperformance aborda as relações e: Gastroperformance addresses the relationships between human beings and food, their instincts and their meanings throughout history. It goes through totemical rituals, medieval dinners and the symbolic value of food in its interface with faith, until it reaches the present, when two opposite realities become equally banal: fast food and its antithesis, the high international gastronomy. Eating apart from thinking is not what this action proposes. Como Penso Como part of a free gastronomy, able to think autonomously of reality.
Quase tudo nesta gastroperformance foi c: Almost everything in this gastroperformance was designed and produced especially for her: the environments, music, dishes, cups, food, poems and images. These elements created a unique tasting experience, composed of nine dishes served over approximately ninety minutes, in two daily sessions for thirty people.
O cortejo gastronômico se desdobrou em n: The gastronomic procession unfolded into nine scenes of food design, a result of four years of research. Its sixty recipes comprised a complete meal that symbolically represented aspects of Brazil, such as religious syncretism, Cinema Novo, the 1928 Anthropophagic Manifesto, Tropicalism, corruption and etiquette books.
Ao revisitar com humor hábitos e costume: By revisiting habits and customs that participated in the formation of national culture, the work proposed a possible identity for Brazilian gastronomy without intending to define it.
Procedimentos próprios do design — como: Design-specific procedures — such as three-dimensional modeling, molding and different means of reproduction — have been displaced to create crispy cassava luminaries, edible papers, graviola laces, chocolate printed texts, 3D sardine heads, banana-shaped chocolates and many other elements.
Juntos, esses objetos compunham um janta: Together, these objects composed a dinner of Brazilian history lived through gastroperformance.

Os nove pratos de Como Penso Como são ap: The nine dishes of Como Penso Como are presented as acts of an edible narrative. Each articulates food, object, sound, performance and references of Brazilian history and culture.
A partir daqui, a apresentação percorre: From here, the presentation goes through these acts individually, revealing their ideas, subjects and ways of serving.
O jantar começa com Grande Poder, prato: Dinner begins with Great Power, a dish inspired by a song by the Alagoan composer Mestre Verdelinho and the legend of manioc, according to which the prophecy of a shaman about the emergence of an unknown plant was followed by the birth of Mani. After the girl's death, her grave was taken by a plant whose root proved nutritious and became called manioc.
O prato, a canção e a lenda celebram a m: The dish, song and legend celebrate cassava as one of the most indigenous contributions present in Brazilian cuisine. Great Power is an edible lamp made of cassava paper, with indigenous graphisms printed in relief. The drawings also appear on the wooden base, which contains small portions: crispy cassava and tacaca muffins. Next door, duck cured with arubé sauce, kind of indigenous mustard prepared with tucupi and granulated cassava flour.
A Cabeça do Bispo explora o tema do cani: The Bishop's Head explores the theme of human cannibalism and proposes to review the gastronomy from concepts formulated by the Antropophagous Manifesto of 1928. The title plays with the account of the first Brazilian cannibal dinner, whose main course would have been Bishop Sardinha, devoured by the Caetés on the northeastern coast in the 16th century.
A obra associa metaforicamente a ingestã: The work metaphorically associates the bishop's ingestion with gastronomy and modernity. Ingering evokes the construction of identity: as Brazilians, we are constantly incorporating the other — foreign foods, fast food, international standards — and digesting what you can add to our own kitchen.
Técnicas de modelagem 3D dão forma a uma: 3D modeling techniques form a silver head of grilled sardine mousse with oriental sauce, served on crispy bread engraved with fossils. A sheet of açaí has printed the Manifesto Como Penso Como, recited in full during tasting.
Este prato se inspira no Baile da Ilha F: This dish is inspired by the Fiscal Island Ball, the last major celebration of the Brazilian monarchy before the proclamation of the Republic. The dream, traditional Portuguese sweet, gains a salty version that ironizes the inability of the ball to sustain the monarchic power in the face of the republican threat. Six days later, Brazil would be proclaimed Republic.
O Sonho Real é preparado com massa de so: The Royal Dream is prepared with a dream mass flavoured with oregano and filled with cod brandade. The crown is made of crispy garlic and Maldon salt diamonds. Under the dream, there is cod with maxixe cured in seafood sauce. The small cushion of cold porcelain represents the Portuguese nobility and receives, in golden printing, a reproduction of the menu served at the ball.
Na performance que acompanha o prato, os: In the performance that accompanies the dish, the actors play with the ingredients of dinner and satirize the extinction of the mutum before a real dream that did not come true.
AR DE PRECES, PSICOGRAFADO POR OLUMARÉ: AR DE PRECES, PSICOGRAFADO POR OLUMARÉ
Este prato parte das raízes africanas pr: This dish starts from the African roots present in Brazilian cuisine. It is a tribute to the Orixás, inspired by the rites of Candomblé and its food offerings. Food occupies a fundamental place in these ceremonies: it is vital force, creative and generous principle, capable of concentrating energy and strengthening ancestors.
Ar de Preces representa Iemanjá, Ogum e: Ar de Preces represents Iemanjá, Ogum and Exu through three amulets made of rice flour and coconut milk dough. Each receives a particular offering: yam, fish, shrimp and garlic flower for Iemanjá; palm wine and okra for Ogum; capon and pepper for Exu.
No centro do prato há uma esfera transpa: In the center of the dish there is a transparent and edible sphere that releases aromatized smoke with spices and cola nuts. The sugar ball rests on acaçá, cream of white corn and lemon, finished with vatapá sauce and acarajé farofa.
PERIPÉCIAS DE BODE NO REINO DOS BACANAS: PERIPÉCIAS DE BODE NO REINO DOS BACANAS
Inspirado no universo do cangaço e de La: Inspired by the universe of cangaço and Lampião, the dish gathers goat, pumpkin and rice palette, recurrent ingredients in the Northeast. Everything is presented in a marquee in the form of mandacaru, produced by one of the few remaining masters of the chiseling technique of the region.
O arroz cateto, proveniente de pequenos: Cateto rice from small family farmers is prepared with pumpkin water, meat broth, bottle butter and half-cured cheese. The glacated goat palette dialogues with the aesthetics of Lampião and his flock. Next door, puddle, palm jam, peanut siphoned cake and beldroega.
O mandacaru também remete ao Abaporu, de: The mandacaru also refers to the Abaporu, Tarsila do Amaral, and the devotional elements present in the clothes of the cangaço. Two sides of a coin — God on one side and the devil on the other — refer to God and the Devil on the Sun Land of Glauber Rocha. The dish creates a metaphor between the ingredients and the Brazilian people: both must resist harsh climates to exist.
Ossos do Ofício homenageia mulheres de u: Bones of the Office honors women from a community in Mato Grosso do Sul benefited by a social project dedicated to crafts. One of the local activities reuses bovine bones collected on farms in the region, carefully scraped and carved until they become ivory.
O prato é servido sobre essas esculturas: The dish is served on these individual sculptures, which represent the regional fauna. The composition brings cured, fried and crispy pancetta, citrus fruit puree, rib ragù, pumpkin cream with Canastra cheese, organic vegetable pickles, edible flowers and chimichurri of yerba mate. During the service, a rap celebrates Brazilian crafts.
Inspirado em Carmen Miranda, em suas pul: Inspired by Carmen Miranda, her bracelets, fruit hats and the phrase Banana is my business, this dish questions the stereotyped image of a Brazil sold at the price of gold and presents a cuisine conscious of itself, marked by humor.
A expressão a preço de banana aparece em: The expression at banana price appears in ironic counterpoint at gold price by means of a fake banana covered in gold paint. At the same time, the banana as a symbol of national identity carries spontaneity, joy and the contradiction of a country that does not always recognize its deepest values.
O prato é um doce em forma de banana fei: The dish is a banana-shaped sweet made of caramelised white chocolate mousse, stuffed with banana jam and covered by a golden layer of cinnamon over a thin slice of cheese. The piece is presented in a cold porcelain sculpture that refers to Carmen Miranda's bracelets.
Inspirado na Festa do Divino, Conflito!: Inspired by the Feast of the Divine, Conflict! addresses Catholic influence in Brazilian food. The celebration refers to a 14th-century conflict between her husband and the son of Queen Elizabeth of Portugal, who would have prayed to the Holy Spirit for peace. The dish recalls that, despite the conciliation evoked by the party, the world around remains crossed by wars and disputes.
A Pomba do Divino, símbolo de paz e harm: The Dove of the Divine, symbol of peace and harmony, rests in the center of the dish surrounded by turmoil. A sweet bonfire is made of creamy chocolate with pepper, cupuaçu jam, baru nuts and cocoa cake bathed in white chocolate. Around, chocolate mousse with pepper and crispy araçá print the names of countries marked by conflicts. A rap on the same themes accompanies the service.
O jantar termina com um tabuleiro que re: Dinner ends with a board that recovers sweets present in different childhoods of the collective imagination, evoking sensations of sounds, smells, shapes and textures. Paçoca, guavada, popcorn and graviola candy appear as recognizable references throughout the country.
Tabuleiro Brasileiro se inspira na histó: Brazilian Board is inspired by the story of Manuela, a sweet woman who found love and freedom through her board, as well as so many other women who live from the sale of quitutes and often appear in Brazilian art and imagination.
Cantoras vestidas como baianas oferecem: Singers dressed as Bahians offer the sweets to the participants: peanut mousse paçoca wrapped in coconut leaf, cheese mousse with guava on guava paper, tapioca in the form of sweet popcorn and jabuticaba bullet. Everything rests on an edible income of graviola, inviting the public to experience again the flavors of childhood.

Os projetos a seguir apresentam experiên: The following projects present experiences already conducted by Simone Mattar and show how food, space, form and participation can structure sensory narratives.
Concreto Efêmero e Pé de Verso integram: Concreto Efêmero and Pé de Verso are part of the repertoire that guides the development of proposals designed for Bradesco.
Concreto Efêmero (2017) foi uma instalaç: Concreto Efêmero (2017) was an installation created for the Brazilian booth at the Anuga Food Fair in Cologne, Germany, for ApexBrasil — Brazilian Agency for the Promotion of Exports and Investments. The installation consisted of small chocolate cubes on three surfaces of a much larger cube inspired by the concrete artwork of sculptor Franz Weissmann.
Pé de Verso, de 2018, foi uma gastroperf: Pé de Verso (2018) was a gastroperformance created for chef Alex Atala’s FRU.TO at the invitation of ApexBrasil. Using a tree as a symbol of the relationship between humankind and nature, visitors “picked” edible fruit from the installation. The menu celebrated Brazilian biodiversity with native ingredients from four biomes: baru and mangaba from the Cerrado; guaraná, cupuaçu and açaí from the Amazon; seriguela and cashew from the Caatinga; and cambuci from the Atlantic Forest. The recipes featured wild Amazonian cacao, umburana cachaça and chocolate colored with natural dyes. The presentation evoked Pernambuco’s bolo de rolo.
O cardápio valorizava a biodiversidade b: The menu valued the Brazilian biodiversity with native ingredients of four biomes: baru and mangaba do cerrado; guaraná, cupuaçu and açaí da Amazônia; seriguela and caju da caatinga; cambuci da Mata Atlântica. The recipes were based on Amazonian wild cocoa, cachaça in umburana and chocolate dyed with natural dyes. The presentation reminded me of the Pernambuco roll cake.
Inspiração no teatro Sleep No More, de N: Inspiration at New York's Sleep No More Theatre, the Microtheater Por Dinero, Madrid, and the Eu Mundo project, gastroperformance held in space The House in Pinheiros, São Paulo, in 2018.
Uma experiência imersiva e gastronômica: An immersive and gastronomic experience that subverts the traditional relationship between audience, food and scenic space. From the moment he enters the environment, the viewer is transported into the narrative, becoming an active participant in a sensory dinner — and not just a passive observer.
O grande trunfo da encenação está na nar: The great asset of staging is in nonlinear narrative, in which the audience follows the actors through different rooms. Edible scenarios and dishes tell parts of the story, while fragmented scenes of a multisensory experience gradually come together in a larger plot. The freedom to explore space at your own pace, choosing which delicacy to prove, which character to follow or which hidden corners to investigate, makes each moment personal, exciting and unique. It is an invitation for those seeking something unconventional, surprising and truly unforgettable.
Inspiração no Brunch Concretista, realiz: Inspiration at the Concrete Brunch, held in a private gallery for the UBS Bank, in São Paulo, and the Pé de Verso project, carried out for the Brazilian government in the Unibes Cultural Space.
Esta gastroperformance é um brunch imers: This gastroperformance is an immersive brunch inspired by an artistic movement focused on light and space. The experience shifts the look of the present to explore the horizon of the future, transforming the guests into an active part of an ecosystem shaped by different times and rhythms. With the conduction of actors, the environment shapes light to transform it into an almost tactile presence. This atmosphere alters the visual and sensory perception of the public, using the game between movement and pause to awaken the senses and make room for contemplation.
O ponto alto da experiência é a desterri: The highlight of the experience is deterritorialization: the traditional table is replaced by a suspended stone sculpture. This floating stone reverses the senses; what was rigid and heavy gains lightness and fluidity, showing that the future is not a fixed ground, but a volume that defies gravity. Integrated to this levitating monument, supports and food mimic mineral textures and merge to the visual narrative, inviting the viewer to experience a reality in constant transformation.

Uma iniciativa do Instituto de Gastroper: An initiative of the Institute of Gastroperformance in partnership with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
É uma organização privada sem fins lucra: It is a private non-profit organization created to promote, articulate and disseminate projects and research related to Gastroperformance.
O termo Gastroperformance, criado pela a: The term Gastroperformance, created by artist and food designer Simone Mattar, proposes new reflections on the relations between gastronomy, art and design, expanding its limits to address issues still little contemplated in traditional academic and professional spaces.
O Instituto nasce da necessidade de cons: The Institute is born of the need to consolidate this area of research and creation, expanding its presence in contemporary debate.
Sua atuação compreende a realização de s: Its work includes symposia, exhibitions, publications and cultural projects, as well as the formation of collaborative networks aimed at experimentation and the circulation of knowledge.
Realizado em parceria com o Ministério d: Conducted in partnership with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the I International Symposium on Gastroperformance and Food Design is one of the Institute's first initiatives designed to consolidate itself as an annual event.
em âmbito internacional parte da necessi: at international level it is necessary to understand food as a cross-sectional object of research, artistic creation and knowledge production, bringing together art, design, science, technology, anthropology, culture and socio-environmental issues. The Symposium connects the
dimensões educacional, social, cultural: educational, social, cultural and artistic dimensions
, propondo novas perspectivas conceituai: , proposing new conceptual and practical perspectives on food and its multiple contexts.
Mais do que nutriente, o alimento consti: More than nutrient, food is a complex system that involves production, distribution and access, cultural habits, technological development, sustainability and the future of food.
Em um mundo cada vez mais interligado, n: In an increasingly interconnected world, in which local actions have a global impact, issues such as climate change, food security, waste and inequality of access require diverse perspectives and shared responses. The presence of researchers, artists and thinkers from various countries allows confronting realities and repertoires facing challenges of global reach.
O contato entre experiências culturais a: The contact between cultural experiences expands references for the review of practices and methodologies, while favoring the recognition and preservation of local identities and knowledge. These meetings can unfold into publications, joint projects and cooperation agreements between institutions.
Para estudantes, docentes e pesquisadore: For students, teachers and researchers, the Symposium stimulates dissertations, theses, articles and experimental projects, contributing to the consolidation of Gastroperformance as an area of investigation and critical thinking about the transformations that cross our relationship with food.
Sua dimensão internacional é, portanto,: Its international dimension is therefore constitutive of the proposal, gathering knowledge and experiences from various territories to think about issues that belong to all.

A Gastroperformance interage com o desig: Gastroperformance interacts with design as a strategy for the sustainability of food chains and for the construction of gastronomic identities. By valuing the relationships between food and territory, it provides new perceptions about regions, cities and neighborhoods, strengthening affective bonds between people and places.
Nesse contexto, utiliza ferramentas de b: In this context, it uses branding tools to recognize and communicate cultural characteristics specific to each territory, valuing ancestral or traditional foods and practices, its recreation in the present and the preservation of species. This approach mobilizes knowledge and practices capable of associating gastronomy and social development, involving communities, organizations and government in formulating strategies that contribute to local economies and sustainable gastronomic tourism.
Há séculos, a França constrói sua identi: For centuries, France has built its gastronomic identity linking products such as Champagne, Cognac and Roquefort to its territories and knowledge, protecting producing families and transforming origin into world heritage and recognition.

O termo Gastroperformance surge no cenár: The term Gastroperformance appears in the contemporary scenario in order to reflect and propose contours for a form of artistic expression that makes the act of eating and the aesthetic and cultural possibilities of food forms of language. Their multisensory experiences are based on the ephemerality and sensitive characteristics of food to produce reflection.
Cores, formas e texturas estabelecem rel: Colors, shapes and textures establish direct relationships with the materiality of art. At the same time, food carries a symbolic dimension consisting of rituals, ancestral knowledge, cultural habits and contents of the collective unconscious.
Tendo o pensamento crítico como premissa: With critical thinking as the premise of the artistic field, Gastroperformance resignifies the notion of “cooking art” by dislocating food from its usual function and incorporating it into a sensitive reality, in which it acquires its own language.
Os hábitos alimentares tornam-se vias de: Eating habits become ways of accessing memory, affections and forms of sociability. Through them, food reveals values and meanings related to identity, belonging and relationships that a society establishes with itself and with its surroundings.
No campo da Gastronomia Social e Ambient: In the field of Social and Environmental Gastronomy, the proposal includes food from its ecological, social, economic and cultural relationships, welcoming initiatives committed to the balance of food systems and a critical analysis of current production, distribution and consumption models.
Nesse contexto, propõe refletir sobre as: In this context, it proposes to reflect on the contradictions of a scenario in which overproduction and waste coexist with hunger, food insecurity and different forms of malnutrition. Climate, sanitary, economic and geopolitical crises make it even more urgent to discuss the use of natural resources and the conditions for access to food.
A proposta contempla práticas de preserv: The proposal includes practices of environmental preservation and regeneration, such as recycling nutrients and energy, and stimulates actions related to agroecology, health promotion, biodiversity and conservation of natural goods, bringing together scientific knowledge, traditional knowledge and local practices.
Busca ainda fortalecer o desenvolvimento: It also seeks to strengthen sustainable development through cooperation between institutions, public agencies, communities and civil society, in addition to promoting gastronomic entrepreneurship and circular economy models capable of generating income and strengthening local productive chains.
O projeto pretende articular discursos e: The project aims to articulate creative discourses and methodologies that bring together the academic and professional fields. It also proposes to stimulate reflection on the issues addressed earlier, through disciplines such as gastronomy, design, nutrition, economy, ecology, anthropology, sociology and arts.
A Gastroperformance abre, assim, novas p: Gastroperformance thus opens new possibilities in the creative and theoretical fields, from a questioning approach that privileges multidimensional thinking in the various contexts in which food is inserted.
Em resumo, o Simpósio é um espaço de enc: In short, the Symposium is a meeting space between disciplines and doings such as gastronomy, design, art and culture questioning the boundaries between professional, academic and creative territories, reviewing established ideas and concepts.
Aberto a estudantes, educadores, designe: Open to students, educators, designers, artists, entrepreneurs linked to gastronomy, chefs, researchers and other interested parties, the event brings together conversations, meetings, courses, tastings, creations, collective meals, performances, exhibitions and shows of films in different cultural and gastronomic spaces.
As experiências propostas convidam o púb: The proposed experiences invite the public to actively participate in the actions, sharing processes and contributing to the collective production of new meanings.
O projeto recupera a origem da palavra s: The project recovers the origin of the symposium word, the Greek symposium, which designated a meeting around the table, in which one ate and drank while intellectual dialogues and conversations were held, accompanied by dance and music presentations. In place of a traditional symposium, participants gather at tables of conversation around meals, calling for inter and transdisciplinary dialogue around contemporary and urgent topics.
Programada em dois momentos, a proposta: Scheduled in two moments, the proposal begins with an academic action conducted by members of the Gastroperformance Institute.
Estudantes de graduação de diferentes in: Graduate students from different Brazilian institutions, in the fields of gastronomy, design, art and fashion, will develop projects under mentoring and coordination of the team of the Institute and invited professionals. The proposals will be monitored and evaluated throughout the process and can integrate the menu and experience of the Como Penso Como Symposium, open to the public.
Os trabalhos desenvolvidos poderão ainda: The work developed may also comprise a collective exhibition, bringing together the production of students from different regions of Brazil and expanding the exchange between training, research and creation.
Os temas a serem abordados serão definid: The topics to be addressed will be defined from the dialogue with invited experts. Among the possibilities, we highlight:
O papel da mulher nas políticas de segur: The role of women in food security policies.
Identidade e pertencimento das populaçõe: Identity and belonging of populations through food.
Antropofagia na sociedade contemporânea: Anthropophagy in contemporary society from Oswald de Andrade.
Educação alimentar nos programas de educ: Food education in early childhood education programs.
Rituais e símbolos presentes no ato de c: Rituals and symbols present in the act of eating throughout history.
Holodomor: a fome como estratégia de pod: Holodomor: hunger as a strategy of power.
Os especialistas serão selecionados por: The experts will be selected by a commission of invited independent curators, and the public will attend the tables in order of registration. Audiovisual works and performances will integrate the space of meals, expanding the experience of the symposium. The meeting will be recorded and made available later, expanding its reach beyond the in-person audience.
O encontro busca promover conexões entre: The meeting seeks to promote connections between participants and experts from different areas of knowledge. The audiovisual records, planned to be available on digital platforms, in addition to content for social networks and podcasts, extend the duration of the Symposium and expand its reach, reaching new audiences and allowing to measure views, accesses and engagement.
A Mostra Como Penso Como expande o Simpó: The Como Penso Como exhibition expands the Symposium to the arts field, bringing together installations, performances, videos, sculptures and collective projects that explore food as language and field of reflection. The proposal establishes dialogues between art, gastronomy, design, communication, politics, anthropology and sociology.
Entre as referências curatoriais está o: Among the healing references is the concept of Social Sculpture, by Joseph Beuys, which understands human thought and action as forces of social, political and cultural transformation. He is added to Lumbung's concept, which guided the 15th document from collective principles, resource sharing and equitable distribution.
A mostra contempla coletivos e artistas: The show includes collectives and independent artists, as well as honoring people who thought of food as an expressive medium.
